settings_ai_hint: Choose a provider, enable the service, then enter the connection details. The API key is stored for this clinic and never shown in full after saving.
settings_ai_help_openai_body: Supports image analysis via vision models such as gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini. Good for text reports from an X-ray image.
settings_ai_help_openai_need_key: Required: an API key from the OpenAI platform (usually starts with sk-).
settings_ai_help_openai_need_model: Required: a vision model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or gpt-4o.
settings_ai_help_gemini_body: Supports image analysis via Gemini. Get a key from Google AI Studio; requests go to the Gemini API directly.
settings_ai_help_gemini_need_key: Required: an API key from Google AI Studio.
settings_ai_help_gemini_need_model: Required: a model such as gemini-2.0-flash or gemini-1.5-flash.
settings_ai_help_compatible_body: For any service that exposes an OpenAI-style Chat Completions API with vision (proxies, or Azure in compatible mode).
settings_ai_help_compatible_need_model: Required: the model name as defined by that provider.
settings_ai_help_compatible_need_url: Required: a Base URL that usually ends with /v1.
settings_ai_api_key_kept: Saved key ({{hint}}) — leave blank to keep, or enter a new key
settings_ai_base_url_hint: Optional for OpenAI — leave empty for the default, or set an Azure/proxy URL.
settings_ai_base_url_hint_compatible: Example: https://api.example.com/v1 — must support /chat/completions with images.
settings_ai_status_ready: Status: ready for on-demand analysis from the patient file.
settings_ai_status_off: Status: not ready — enable and add an API key (and a base URL for compatible providers).
settings_ai_privacy_note: Privacy note: when you run analysis, the X-ray image is sent to your configured external AI provider (e.g. OpenAI or Google). Only use this if the clinic consents to sharing the image for that purpose.
settings_wa_hint: Connect WhatsApp to send appointment confirmations, reminders, payment receipts, and balance notices. Tokens stay on the server only.
settings_wa_phone_note: Note: both 972 (Israel) and 970 (Palestine) are accepted. Local numbers like 05… are converted automatically; if unsure, both codes are tried.
settings_wa_help_meta_body: Recommended for production. Proactive messages need Meta-approved templates. Enter Phone Number ID and token from Meta for Developers.
settings_wa_help_compatible_body: Faster for trials via a gateway with API key and Base URL. Sends free-form text through the gateway API.
settings_wa_api_token_kept: Saved token ({{hint}}) — leave blank to keep or enter a new one
settings_wa_default_country: Default country code for local numbers
settings_wa_cc_hint: Used when the number has no country code. Numbers already saved as 970 or 972 are kept as-is. For ambiguous local numbers, both codes are tried on send.
settings_wa_auto_appointment: WhatsApp confirm when creating an appointment
settings_wa_auto_payment: WhatsApp confirm after posting a receipt
settings_wa_status_off: Status: not ready — enable and provide a token (and Phone Number ID for Meta or Base URL for gateway).
wa_receipt_auto_note: WhatsApp confirmation is sent automatically after posting (per clinic settings).
clinical_ai_privacy_note: Running analysis sends this image to the external AI provider for processing.
